name: Jairus Daughter
overview: The story of Jairus' daughter highlights a powerful demonstration of faith and Jesus' authority over life and death. Jairus, a synagogue ruler, humbly approached Jesus, pleading for healing as his daughter was near death, and later receiving the devastating news of her death (Matthew 9:18; Mark 5:22, 35; Luke 8:41). Despite this, Jesus' response reveals His compassion and power to bring life, affirming His divine ability to restore even the seemingly hopeless. The people's eager reception of Jesus upon His return underscores the anticipation of His miraculous works (Mark 5:21; Luke 8:40).
